Free keys of your own for what 30nama doesn\'t carry: TMDB for Persian names, trending and trailers; SubDL and OpenSubtitles for finding subtitles in the player. Keys stay on this TV only.

TMDB, the film database, brings the trending row, trailers, More Like This, episode stills and Persian names where 30nama has none. Take a free key from the API page of your TMDB account; the API Key and the API Read Access Token both work.
SubDL, which holds Subscene\'s Persian archive, comes first in the player\'s Find subtitles. Sign up, then take your free key from the API page of your account panel.
In the player\'s Find subtitles, OpenSubtitles comes after SubDL. Sign up, create a consumer on the API consumers page and take its API key. A free key downloads 5 subtitles a day.
